experiments.question: Can agents avoid confidence inflation when many documents descend from one source?
experiments.null: Root-aware aggregation does not improve calibration under source laundering.
experiments.target: Lower confidently false answers without loss on genuinely independent evidence.
experiments.firstGate: Twenty paraphrases of one false source must remain one root.
experiments.sharedBlocker: real-world ground truth: this experiment asks how much root-aware aggregation helps in its domain, which is a RATE. KL-001 established that a rate measured over a corpus the researcher composed reads back generator settings rather than a measurement (DESIGN-v0.4.md), so this question cannot be settled synthetically at any corpus size. It needs real data with independently established ground truth, which nothing in this programme solves.
